triggers.name: auto_noop_consume
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER auto_noop_consume AFTER INSERT ON memory_decision WHEN NEW.action='auto_noop' AND NEW.outcome='applied' BEGIN INSERT INTO decision_candidate(owner_id,decision_id,candidate_id,relation_kind,accepted_state_revision) SELECT DISTINCT NEW.owner_id,NEW.id,i.candidate_id,'accepted',i.accepted_state_revision FROM execution_event e JOIN execution_input x ON x.owner_id=e.owner_id AND x.event_id=e.id AND x.role='candidate' JOIN step_input i ON i.owner_id=x.owner_id AND i.step_id=x.planned_step_id AND i.input_no=x.planned_input_no AND i.kind='candidate' WHERE e.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND e.step_attempt_id=NEW.execution_id AND e.kind='adjudication_result' AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.candidateId')=i.candidate_id; SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'auto_noop_consumption') WHERE changes()<>1; UPDATE memory_candidate SET state='duplicate',state_revision=state_revision+1 WHERE owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND state='pending' AND id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM decision_candidate WHERE owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND decision_id=NEW.id); SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'auto_noop_consumption') WHERE changes()<>1; END

triggers.name: auto_retire_execution
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER auto_retire_execution BEFORE INSERT ON memory_decision WHEN NEW.action='auto_retire' AND NEW.outcome='applied' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM step_attempt a JOIN processing_step s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.step_id JOIN model_operation o ON o.owner_id=s.owner_id AND o.memory_step_id=s.id AND o.purpose='adjudication' JOIN model_call c ON c.owner_id=o.owner_id AND c.operation_id=o.id AND c.state='succeeded' JOIN step_input i ON i.owner_id=s.owner_id AND i.step_id=s.id AND i.kind='memory' JOIN memory m ON m.owner_id=i.owner_id AND m.id=i.memory_id WHERE a.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND a.id=NEW.execution_id AND a.state='succeeded' AND s.state='succeeded' AND s.successful_attempt_id=a.id AND s.kind='adjudication' AND i.memory_id=NEW.target_memory_id AND i.memory_version_no=NEW.expected_version_no AND i.accepted_head_revision=NEW.expected_head_revision AND m.state='active' AND m.manual_protection=0 AND m.current_version_no=i.memory_version_no AND m.head_revision=i.accepted_head_revision AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_decision d JOIN memory_version v ON v.owner_id=d.owner_id AND v.decision_id=d.id WHERE d.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND d.execution_id=NEW.execution_id AND d.actor_kind='system' AND d.action='auto_update' AND d.outcome='applied' AND d.target_memory_id<>NEW.target_memory_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'auto_retire_execution'); END

triggers.name: document_extraction_reuse_scope
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER document_extraction_reuse_scope BEFORE INSERT ON document_extraction_reuse WHEN NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM run_input current JOIN processing_item item ON item.owner_id=current.owner_id AND item.id=current.item_id JOIN step_attempt a ON a.owner_id=current.owner_id AND a.id=NEW.source_attempt_id AND a.state='succeeded' JOIN processing_step s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.step_id AND s.kind='extraction_verification' AND s.state='succeeded' AND s.successful_attempt_id=a.id JOIN processing_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id AND t.scope_kind='contact' AND t.contact_id=current.source_contact_id JOIN step_input si ON si.owner_id=s.owner_id AND si.step_id=s.id AND si.kind='run_message' JOIN run_input original ON original.owner_id=si.owner_id AND original.run_id=si.run_id AND original.input_no=si.run_input_no WHERE current.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND current.run_id=NEW.run_id AND current.input_no=NEW.input_no AND current.role='target' AND item.extraction_state='succeeded' AND original.role='target' AND original.item_id=current.item_id AND original.message_id=current.message_id AND original.source_contact_id=current.source_contact_id AND original.record_id=current.record_id AND original.accepted_interpretation_revision=current.accepted_interpretation_revision) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'document_extraction_reuse_invalid'); END

i.source_contact_id=NEW.source_contact_id UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM execution_input x JOIN reply_context_item i ON i.owner_id=x.owner_id AND i.context_id=x.reply_context_id AND i.item_no=x.context_item_no JOIN discussion_entry d ON d.owner_id=i.owner_id AND d.id=i.entry_id JOIN event_source es ON es.owner_id=d.owner_id AND es.event_id=d.origin_event_id WHERE x.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND x.event_id=NEW.event_id AND i.kind='entry' AND es.record_id=NEW.record_id AND es.source_contact_id=NEW.source_contact_id UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM reply_execution_input x JOIN reply_candidate_input_source s ON s.owner_id=x.owner_id AND s.context_id=x.context_id AND s.item_no=x.item_no WHERE x.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND x.event_id=NEW.event_id AND s.record_id=NEW.record_id AND s.source_contact_id=NEW.source_contact_id UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM execution_input x JOIN step_input i ON i.owner_id=x.owner_id AND i.step_id=x.planned_step_id AND i.input_no=x.planned_input_no WHERE x.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND x.event_id=NEW.event_id AND i.kind='message' AND i.record_id=NEW.record_id AND i.source_contact_id=NEW.source_contact_id UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM execution_input x JOIN step_input i ON i.owner_id=x.owner_id AND i.step_id=x.planned_step_id AND i.input_no=x.planned_input_no JOIN memory_citation c ON c.owner_id=i.owner_id AND i.input_no=x.planned_input_no JOIN step_input q ON q.owner_id=i.owner_id AND q.step_id=i.step_id AND q.kind='message' WHERE x.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND x.event_id=NEW.event_id AND i.kind='memory' AND i.input_no=x.planned_input_no JOIN memory_document_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.document_id=i.document_id AND v.version_no=i.document_version_no JOIN execution_event prior ON prior.owner_id=v.owner_id AND prior.step_attempt_id=v.produced_attempt_id AND prior.kind='document_input' JOIN event_source source ON source.owner_id=prior.owner_id AND source.event_id=prior.id WHERE execution_event e JOIN model_call c ON c.owner_id=e.owner_id AND c.id=e.reused_call_id JOIN model_operation o ON o.owner_id=c.owner_id AND o.id=c.operation_id JOIN reply_attempt a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.id=e.reply_attempt_id WHERE e.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND e.id=NEW.event_id AND a.request_id=o.reply_request_id AND c.reply_context_id=NEW.reply_context_id UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM execution_event result JOIN step_attempt ra ON ra.owner_id=result.owner_id AND ra.id=result.step_attempt_id JOIN processing_step rs ON rs.owner_id=ra.owner_id AND rs.id=ra.step_id JOIN processing_task rt ON rt.owner_id=rs.owner_id AND rt.id=rs.task_id JOIN execution_event source ON source.owner_id=result.owner_id AND source.id=NEW.producer_event_id JOIN step_attempt sa ON sa.owner_id=source.owner_id AND sa.id=source.step_attempt_id JOIN processing_step ss ON ss.owner_id=sa.owner_id AND ss.id=sa.step_id JOIN processing_task st ON st.owner_id=ss.owner_id AND st.id=ss.task_id JOIN task_contribution tc ON tc.owner_id=rt.owner_id AND tc.task_id=rt.id AND tc.run_id=rt.run_id AND tc.source_contact_id=st.contact_id WHERE result.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND result.id=NEW.event_id AND rt.scope_kind='self' AND rt.contact_id IS NULL AND st.scope_kind='contact' AND st.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND st.run_id=rt.run_id AND st.state='succeeded' AND result.kind='verified_output' AND source.kind='verified_self_contribution' AND result.payload=source.payload AND sa.state='succeeded' AND ss.state='succeeded' AND ss.successful_attempt_id=sa.id AND json_extract(source.payload,'$.fact.subject')='self' AND json_extract(source.payload,'$.scopeKind')='self' AND json_extract(source.payload,'$.contactId') IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'execution_input_scope'); END

triggers.name: step_input_scope
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER step_input_scope BEFORE INSERT ON step_input WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM processing_step s JOIN processing_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id JOIN run_input i ON i.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND i.run_id=NEW.run_id AND i.input_no=NEW.run_input_no WHERE NEW.kind='run_message' AND s.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND s.id=NEW.step_id AND t.run_id=NEW.run_id AND (t.scope_kind='self' OR t.contact_id=i.source_contact_id) UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM processing_step s JOIN processing_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id JOIN memory_candidate c ON c.owner_id=t.owner_id AND c.id=NEW.candidate_id WHERE NEW.kind='candidate' AND s.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND s.id=NEW.step_id AND t.scope_kind=c.scope_kind AND t.contact_id IS c.contact_id AND c.state='pending' AND c.state_revision=NEW.accepted_state_revision UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM processing_step s JOIN processing_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id JOIN memory m ON m.owner_id=t.owner_id AND m.id=NEW.memory_id JOIN memory_version v ON v.owner_id=m.owner_id AND v.memory_id=m.id AND v.version_no=NEW.memory_version_no WHERE NEW.kind='memory' AND s.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND s.id=NEW.step_id AND t.scope_kind=m.scope_kind AND t.contact_id IS m.contact_id AND m.current_version_no=v.version_no AND m.head_revision=NEW.accepted_head_revision AND m.state IN ('active','withdrawn') AND v.content_state='present' AND v.provenance_state='eligible' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM processing_step s JOIN processing_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id JOIN message m ON m.owner_id=t.owner_id AND m.contact_id=NEW.source_contact_id AND m.id=NEW.message_id JOIN capture_record r ON r.owner_id=m.owner_id AND r.contact_id=m.contact_id AND r.message_id=m.id AND r.id=NEW.record_id WHERE NEW.kind='message' AND s.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND s.id=NEW.step_id AND (t.scope_kind='self' OR t.contact_id=m.contact_id) AND m.interpretation_revision=NEW.accepted_revision AND m.availability='available' AND r.availability='available' AND r.state='normalized' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_capture sc JOIN read_goal g ON g.owner_id=sc.owner_id AND g.contact_id=sc.contact_id AND g.id=sc.goal_id JOIN contact p ON p.owner_id=r.owner_id AND p.id=r.contact_id JOIN owner o ON o.owner_id=p.owner_id WHERE sc.owner_id=r.owner_id AND sc.contact_id=r.contact_id AND sc.id=r.capture_id AND m.binding_id=g.binding_id AND p.state='active' AND o.state='active') AND EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE versions(memory_id,version_no) AS ( SELECT memory_id,memory_version_no FROM step_input WHERE owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND step_id=NEW.step_id AND kind='memory' UNION SELECT v.memory_id,v.previous_version_no FROM versions a CROSS JOIN memory_version v ON v.memory_id=a.memory_id AND v.version_no=a.version_no WHERE v.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND v.previous_version_no IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT v.memory_id,v.restored_from_version_no FROM versions a CROSS JOIN memory_version v ON v.memory_id=a.memory_id AND v.version_no=a.version_no WHERE v.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND v.restored_from_version_no IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT i.memory_id,i.memory_version_no FROM versions a CROSS JOIN memory_version v ON v.memory_id=a.memory_id AND v.version_no=a.version_no CROSS JOIN memory_decision d ON d.owner_id=v.owner_id AND d.id=v.decision_id CROSS JOIN step_attempt sa ON sa.owner_id=d.owner_id AND sa.id=d.execution_id CROSS JOIN step_input i ON i.owner_id=sa.owner_id AND i.step_id=sa.step_id AND i.kind='memory' WHERE v.owner_id=NEW.owner_id), candidates(candidate_id) AS ( SELECT candidate_id FROM step_input WHERE owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND step_id=NEW.step_id AND kind='candidate' UNION SELECT dc.candidate_id FROM decision_candidate dc JOIN memory_version v ON v.owner_id=dc.owner_id AND v.decision_id=dc.decision_id JOIN versions a ON a.memory_id=v.memory_id AND a.version_no=v.version_no WHERE dc.owner_id=NEW.owner_id), sources(source_contact_id,message_id,record_id,accepted_revision) AS ( SELECT c.source_contact_id,c.message_id,c.record_id,c.accepted_revision FROM memory_citation c WHERE c.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND (c.candidate_id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM candidates) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM versions v WHERE v.memory_id=c.memory_id AND v.version_no=c.version_no)) UNION SELECT i.source_contact_id,i.message_id,i.record_id,i.accepted_interpretation_revision FROM candidates c JOIN memory_candidate mc ON mc.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND mc.id=c.candidate_id JOIN step_attempt a ON a.owner_id=mc.owner_id AND a.id=mc.produced_attempt_id JOIN processing_step ps ON ps.owner_id=a.owner_id AND ps.id=a.step_id JOIN task_contribution tc ON tc.owner_id=ps.owner_id AND tc.task_id=ps.task_id JOIN run_input i ON i.owner_id=tc.owner_id AND i.run_id=tc.run_id AND i.source_contact_id=tc.source_contact_id UNION SELECT i.source_contact_id,i.message_id,i.record_id,i.accepted_revision FROM versions a JOIN memory_version v ON v.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND v.memory_id=a.memory_id AND v.version_no=a.version_no JOIN memory_decision d ON d.owner_id=v.owner_id AND d.id=v.decision_id JOIN step_attempt sa ON sa.owner_id=d.owner_id AND sa.id=d.execution_id JOIN step_input i ON i.owner_id=sa.owner_id AND i.step_id=sa.step_id AND i.kind='message') SELECT 1 FROM sources q WHERE q.source_contact_id=NEW.source_contact_id AND q.message_id=NEW.message_id AND q.record_id=NEW.record_id AND q.accepted_revision=NEW.accepted_revision) UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM processing_step s JOIN processing_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id JOIN memory_document d ON d.owner_id=t.owner_id AND d.id=NEW.document_id JOIN memory_document_version v ON v.owner_id=d.owner_id AND v.document_id=d.id AND v.version_no=NEW.document_version_no WHERE NEW.kind='document' AND s.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND s.id=NEW.step_id AND s.kind IN ('document_scene','document_profile') AND d.scope_kind=t.scope_kind AND d.contact_id IS t.contact_id AND ((NEW.publication_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.publication_id=t.accepted_publication_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_publication p JOIN publication_member pm ON pm.owner_id=p.owner_id AND pm.publication_id=p.id WHERE p.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND p.id=NEW.publication_id AND p.availability='available' AND pm.document_id=NEW.document_id AND pm.version_no=NEW.document_version_no)) OR (NEW.publication_id IS NULL AND s.kind='document_profile' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM step_attempt a JOIN processing_step prior ON prior.owner_id=a.owner_id AND prior.id=a.step_id WHERE a.owner_id=v.owner_id AND a.id=v.produced_attempt_id AND a.state='succeeded' AND prior.task_id=t.id AND prior.kind='document_scene' AND prior.state='succeeded')))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'step_input_scope'); END
